title: Avatars
summary: Ready combinations of avatars: a person with a source, a stacked group with a remainder, an avatar with two lines of label, and a profile avatar with a verified badge. Drawn from sf-avatar's parts; for a single avatar with a name or a card use sf-avatar.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

fields.description: JSON text of the fields the attributes below also take (imageUrl, avatarUrl, avatarSize, active, check, name, source, labelText, labelSecondText, avatars, avatarsMore); an attribute wins over its field

property.description: JSON text of the sizes the attributes round-size, label-size and profile-size also take

image-url.description: The picture of the default, user and profile templates.

avatar-url.description: The picture of the label template.

avatar-size.description: The avatar's size step in the default and user templates (1/4 ... 3; the former words tiny, small, big and extra_big still read).

check.description: Draws the verified badge on the default template's avatar.

name.description: The person's name in the user template.

source.description: The line under the name in the user template, with a link glyph: where the person comes from.

label-text.description: The title of the label template.

label-second-text.description: The line under the title in the label template.

avatars-more.description: The people the group stands for beyond the avatars list: a number adds to «+N» (and to the group's name «Участники: N»); with no list behind it «+N» is text. A short text instead of a number is drawn as is.

round-size.description: The avatars' size step in the group template (and in the default one when given). The avatars overlap by 4 px up to size 1 and 8 px at 2 and 3; the cut-out between them is the presence point's ring, 2 px from 1/2 (C132).

label-size.description: The avatar's size step in the label template.

profile-size.description: The profile template's avatar size step: 2 or 3 (the former words small and big still read).

active.description: Draws the online badge on the default template's avatar; check (verified) wins when both are set.

avatars.description: The group's people (owner decision C152 (6)): each an image (over its initials), its initials (text), its name -- which names the avatar, gives the initials and the hue of the name and shows in a tooltip -- a presence status (online, away) and a named hue. Up to four are shown; with more than four the fifth place is «+N», a button that opens the list of everyone. The attribute takes the list as JSON text too.

accessibility.focus: Nothing here takes focus: every avatar is a decorative picture (alt ""), and the visible text names the person -- name in user, label-text in label. An avatar that opens a profile is an sf-avatar with aria-label inside the host's own link or button.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-avatar-group when the interface needs the avatars behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
